```{=html}
<!-- Overview Map -->
<div class="section-header">Trip Route</div>
<div id="overview-map" class="day-map overview-map"></div>
<script>
(function() {
  var map = L.map('overview-map').setView([36.5, 127.8], 7);
  L.tileLayer('https://{s}.tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png', {
    attribution: '© <a href="https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright">OpenStreetMap</a>'
  }).addTo(map);

  function dot(color) {
    return L.divIcon({
      className: '',
      html: '<div style="width:14px;height:14px;border-radius:50%;background:' + color + ';border:2.5px solid #fff;box-shadow:0 1px 5px rgba(0,0,0,0.4)"></div>',
      iconSize: [14, 14], iconAnchor: [7, 7], popupAnchor: [0, -10]
    });
  }
  function hotelDot() {
    return L.divIcon({ className:'', html:'<div style="width:22px;height:22px;border-radius:50%;background:#4A148C;border:2.5px solid #fff;box-shadow:0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.5);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:12px;line-height:1;color:#fff">★</div>', iconSize:[22,22], iconAnchor:[11,11], popupAnchor:[0,-13] });
  }

  var cities = [
    { name: '✈️ Vancouver (YVR) → Seoul', lat: 37.5547, lng: 126.9706, color: '#C62828', url: '' },
    { name: '🏨 Seoul · Shilla Stay Seodaemun\nJul 27–30', lat: 37.5572, lng: 126.9680, hotel: true, url: 'https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Shilla+Stay+Seodaemun+Seoul' },
    { name: '🌸 Myeongdong', lat: 37.5636, lng: 126.9834, color: '#E53935', url: 'https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Myeongdong+Seoul' },
    { name: '🛍️ Garosugil / Sinsa · Gangnam', lat: 37.5178, lng: 127.0194, color: '#E53935', url: 'https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Garosugil+Sinsa+Seoul' },
    { name: '👘 Gyeongbokgung Palace', lat: 37.5796, lng: 126.9770, color: '#E53935', url: 'https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Gyeongbokgung+Palace' },
    { name: '🪖 DMZ', lat: 37.9355, lng: 126.6783, color: '#795548', url: 'https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=DMZ+Korea' },
    { name: '🏨 Jeju · Grabel Hotel\nJul 31–Aug 3', lat: 33.4996, lng: 126.5312, hotel: true, url: 'https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Grabel+Hotel+Jeju' },
    { name: '🌅 Seongsan Ilchulbong', lat: 33.4583, lng: 126.9422, color: '#1976D2', url: 'https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Seongsan+Ilchulbong' },
    { name: '🕍 Manjanggul Cave', lat: 33.5280, lng: 126.7718, color: '#1976D2', url: 'https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Manjanggul+Cave+Jeju' },
    { name: '🍵 Osulloc Tea Museum', lat: 33.3059, lng: 126.2892, color: '#1976D2', url: 'https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Osulloc+Tea+Museum+Jeju' },
    { name: '🏨 Busan · L7 Haeundae by Lotte Hotels\nAug 4–6', lat: 35.1620, lng: 129.1601, hotel: true, url: 'https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=L7+Haeundae+by+Lotte+Hotels+Busan' },
    { name: '🎨 Gamcheon Culture Village', lat: 35.0975, lng: 129.0147, color: '#43A047', url: 'https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Gamcheon+Culture+Village+Busan' },
    { name: '🚄 KTX → Seoul', lat: 35.1010, lng: 129.0375, color: '#795548', url: '' },
    { name: '🏨 Seoul · Shilla Stay Seodaemun\nAug 7–9', lat: 37.5572, lng: 126.9680, hotel: true, url: 'https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Shilla+Stay+Seodaemun+Seoul+Station' },
    { name: '📚 COEX · Starfield Library', lat: 37.5126, lng: 127.0594, color: '#8B0000', url: 'https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=COEX+Seoul' },
    { name: '🌃 Lotte World Tower', lat: 37.5126, lng: 127.1021, color: '#8B0000', url: 'https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Lotte+World+Tower+Seoul' },
  ];

  cities.forEach(function(c) {
    var m = L.marker([c.lat, c.lng], { icon: c.hotel ? hotelDot() : dot(c.color) }).addTo(map);
    var html = '<b>' + c.name.replace(/\n/g,'<br>') + '</b>';
    if (c.url) html += '<br><a href="' + c.url + '" target="_blank" style="font-size:12px">Open in Maps →</a>';
    m.bindPopup(html);
  });

  // Draw rough route line
  var route = cities.map(function(c) { return [c.lat, c.lng]; });
  L.polyline(route, { color: '#C62828', weight: 2, opacity: 0.4, dashArray: '6,6' }).addTo(map);
})();
</script>
```
